about_the_game:
Embark on an exciting new quest within the world of Faelduum: Dark Ale!

Solve the mystery of what exactly is in a strange ale keg in the basement of Rosalie’s inn. Put not only your combat abilities to the test... but also your taste in ale!

Grab a flagon, Inquisitor, because it’s going to be a long night...
